items.reason: Gap 1 describes the same event delivered twice while the first job runs, with both passing the check before either records the id.
Gap 0 says the eventId is keyed off the X-Event-Id header, which is an unsigned copy, rather than the body's id, and that it can differ between retries.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while only refund.created is registered, so refunds are dropped.
No gap depends on several processes, instances, or replicas.
